commands.notes: Real MySQL via testmysql (PANTHEON_TEST_DSN redacted). Legacy-schema upgrade: a pre-existing global-name-unique table gains tenant_id and the key is rebuilt tenant-first, so two tenants reuse a name while a duplicate inside one tenant still fails.
Business-module migration source and assembly copy are byte-identical (up and down).
48 idempotent dynamic DDL statements: golang-migrate executes statement-by-statement, so each column/index add is guarded by SET @sql := IF(...) ... PREPARE/EXECUTE/DEALLOCATE.

knownGaps: Runtime tenant isolation (two tenants with same-named resources, guessed-ID/export/callback cross-tenant denial) is blocked upstream: Base keyMatch2 makes GET /packages/:id also match /packages/export, so detail routes stay unbound (anti-widening).
compat (tenant_id=0) and multi live upgrade/rollback row-count verification on a real multi-tenant database was not run on this candidate.
Async task restart retaining original tenant not verified end-to-end.
